keyPoints.en: Intersection A ∩ B: the set of elements common to A and B (the overlap in a Venn diagram).
keyPoints.bm: Persilangan A ∩ B: set unsur sepunya A dan B (bahagian bertindih dalam gambar rajah Venn).

keyPoints.en: Three sets: A ∩ B ∩ C is the region common to all three.
keyPoints.bm: Tiga set: A ∩ B ∩ C ialah rantau sepunya ketiga-tiga set.

keyPoints.en: Complement (A ∩ B)′: everything in ξ except the overlap.
keyPoints.bm: Pelengkap (A ∩ B)′: semua dalam ξ kecuali bahagian bertindih.

keyPoints.en: If A ⊂ B then A ∩ B = A. If A and B are disjoint, A ∩ B = ∅.
keyPoints.bm: Jika A ⊂ B maka A ∩ B = A. Jika A dan B terpisah, A ∩ B = ∅.

question.en: ξ = {1, …, 10}, P = multiples of 2, Q = multiples of 3. Find P ∩ Q.
question.bm: ξ = {1, …, 10}, P = gandaan 2, Q = gandaan 3. Cari P ∩ Q.

tip.en: ∩ looks like an upside-down U — think 'AND'.

keyPoints.en: Union A ∪ B: all elements that are in A or B or both (each listed once).
keyPoints.bm: Kesatuan A ∪ B: semua unsur yang dalam A atau B atau kedua-duanya (setiap satu disenarai sekali).

keyPoints.en: n(A ∪ B) = n(A) + n(B) − n(A ∩ B).
keyPoints.bm: n(A ∪ B) = n(A) + n(B) − n(A ∩ B).

keyPoints.en: Complement (A ∪ B)′: elements outside both A and B.
keyPoints.bm: Pelengkap (A ∪ B)′: unsur di luar A dan B.

keyPoints.en: If A ⊂ B then A ∪ B = B.
keyPoints.bm: Jika A ⊂ B maka A ∪ B = B.

tip.en: ∪ looks like a cup holding everything — think 'OR'.
tip.bm: ∪ seperti cawan yang menampung semua — fikir 'ATAU'.

keyPoints.en: Combined operations mix ∩, ∪ and ′. Do brackets first, like in arithmetic.
keyPoints.bm: Gabungan operasi mencampurkan ∩, ∪ dan ′. Selesaikan kurungan dahulu, seperti aritmetik.

keyPoints.en: Shade step by step: shade the bracket, then apply the outer operation.
keyPoints.bm: Lorek langkah demi langkah: lorek kurungan, kemudian guna operasi luar.

keyPoints.en: Word problems: draw a Venn diagram, fill the innermost region first, then work outwards.
keyPoints.bm: Masalah berayat: lukis gambar rajah Venn, isi rantau paling dalam dahulu, kemudian bergerak ke luar.

keyPoints.en: Use x for unknown regions and form an equation using the total n(ξ).
keyPoints.bm: Guna x untuk rantau tidak diketahui dan bentuk persamaan menggunakan jumlah n(ξ).

question.en: ξ = 50 students. 28 like Maths, 25 like Science, 8 like neither. How many like only Science?
question.bm: ξ = 50 pelajar. 28 suka Matematik, 25 suka Sains, 8 tidak suka kedua-duanya. Berapa orang suka Sains sahaja?

tip.en: Check: all regions must add up to n(ξ).
tip.bm: Semak: semua rantau mesti berjumlah n(ξ).
